release-item.p: Remove support for PostgreSQL 9.0/9.1/9.2.
now supports ten versions of : the five supported versions and the last five EOL versions. As of 15 that excludes 9.0, 9.1, and 9.2.
Restore errors when no backup matches the current version of .

After a stanza-upgrade with no new backup, restore used the latest backup, which was made from the prior version. Replicas built this way could fail. Restore now errors in this case unless set or type=time/type=lsn is specified.
Add compress-level range checking for each compress-type.
The compress-level range was 0-9 for every compress-type. This is the range for gz but a subset of what lz4 and zst allow. Each type now has its own range, e.g. -7 to 22 for zst.

release-item.p: Clean up code and comments.
Update LICENSE.txt and PostgreSQL copyright for 2023.
Add warning about enabling hierarchical namespace on Azure storage.
With hierarchical namespace enabled, Azure requires directories to be deleted separately and expire fails. The user guide now warns not to enable it.
Add replacement for linefeeds in monitoring example.

The monitoring example failed when info output contained a linefeed, e.g. in some error messages, because COPY converts \n to a linefeed that jsonb rejects. The example now replaces linefeeds before converting to jsonb.
Clarify target-action behavior on various versions.
The effect of pause depends on hot_standby and the version. With hot_standby=off, pause acts like shutdown on >= 12 and like promote on earlier versions.
Updates and clarifications to index page.
The section about other backup solutions not supporting parallel processing was no longer accurate and has been reworded. Other sections were updated for current terminology and clarity.
Add dark mode to the website.
The website uses dark colors when the browser prefers a dark color scheme.
Update RHEL user guide to PostgreSQL 11/12.
